On-Chain Operator. Lesson 10.4, Options income: covered calls, cash-secured puts, options vaults. Navy and cyan. One idea at a time. You write it down. Education only.
You already split base yield from emissions. Advanced yield still starts with that split, then names a more particular engine.
Covered call: you hold the asset and sell someone the right to buy it from you at a higher strike.
You keep the premium, and your upside is capped at the strike.
Cash-secured put: you hold stablecoins and sell someone the right to sell you the asset at a lower strike.
If price falls below the strike, you buy at the strike.
The wheel: sell puts until assigned → hold the asset → sell calls until called away → repeat.
They add contract risk and you don't choose the strikes.
